references.text: The same warning about sevenfold punishment for sin, showing God's escalating discipline when the people do not repent
Repetition of the expression 'walk contrary to me' (קֶרִי) and sevenfold punishment
Yet another repetition of the warning about walking in rebellion against God and the sevenfold punishment
Parallel text about curses and plagues that come upon those who refuse to listen to the Lord's voice
Proverbs warns against despising the Lord's discipline, which is linked to the consequences of not listening
Isaiah describes how continued rebellion leads to more blows and plagues
Jeremiah laments that the people would not accept discipline, parallel to refusing to listen
Amos describes repeated plagues God sent, but the people did not turn back - 'you did not turn to me'
Hebrews speaks of the Lord's discipline of those he loves, showing God's purpose in punishment
Revelation shows people who did not repent despite plagues, parallel to refusing to listen
